messages.subject: save the STRUCTRE file
parts:
Hi all, 
I would like to knwo if somebody could help me with this question. I run the structure function and I have the object in my RStudio global environment, I forgot to change the save2tmp option to TRUE and my computer spent 13 hours runing.  I want to save it as a structure file because I need to run the structure selector. Some papers have been saying that Structure is not always the  same method for determinating the K number and I would like to be sure that the evano chose the best K because every time that I change the k range the k evano stimation changes as well.
Thank you so much for your help,
Laia

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: save the STRUCTRE file
parts:
Hi Laia,

If you stored the results of gl.run.structure into a variable, for example:

> bc <- bandicoot.gl[,1:100]
> sr <- gl.run.structure(bc, k.range = 2:5, num.k.rep = 3, exec = './structure.exe')

The information should be still in your environment in the variable sr.

The option save2tmp only saves the plot in the temporary directory not the final results of the function, so it is not that bad that you forgot to set it to TRUE.

With the structure selector, do you mean the Evanno method?

Yes, it is expected that when you run Structure at different independent times you will get different results, because Structure uses a probabilistic model (Markov Chain Monte Carlo), not a deterministic one, to find the answer. That's why it is recommended to run Structure up to 20 replicates for each K. Another possible reason that you are getting different results is that there is not a strong genetic structure in your dataset, which could mean that the best answer is K = 1.

Let us know if we can help further.

Cheers,
Luis

messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Re: save the STRUCTRE file
parts:
Hi Laia,

Please find below some code to generate the input files for the Structure selector. Note that you have to choose the ADMIXTURE option as the format of the file.

Cheers,
Luis

devtools::install_github("EricArcher/strataG")

library(strataG)
library(dartR)

bc <- bandicoot.gl[,1:100]
sr <- gl.run.structure(bc, k.range = 2:5, num.k.rep = 3, exec = './structure.exe')

# writing q matrices
lapply(sr,function(x){
  write.table(x[[2]][,4:ncol(x[[2]])],
                                  file = paste0("inputfile_k_",
                                                gsub(".*k(.+)....*", "\\1",x$label),
                                                "_r_",
                                                gsub(".*r(.+).*", "\\1",x$label),
                                                ".",
                                                gsub(".*k(.+)....*", "\\1",x$label),
                                                ".Q"),
                                  row.names = F,
                                  col.names = F,
                                  quote = F)
  })
# zipping files
zip_files <- list.files(pattern ="inputfile")
zip("struc_file.zip",zip_files)
# writing popmap file
pop_map <- sr[[2]][[2]][,c(1,3)]
write.table(pop_map,"PopMap.txt" ,row.names = F,col.names = F, quote = F)
